description:
Compute an HMAC (RFC 2104) with SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-384 or SHA-512 and return it in hex, Base64 and Base64url. Optionally build a GitHub, Stripe or Slack webhook signature, and check an expected signature with a constant-time comparison.

Returns: JSON { algorithm, hex, base64, base64url, bits, key_bytes, message_bytes, signed_string, header, match } where match is null unless `expected` was given.
Example input: {"message":"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog","key":"key","algorithm":"SHA-256"}
On error, includes hint: `algorithm` is SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-384 or SHA-512; `key_encoding` and `message_encoding` are utf8, hex or base64; `preset` is plain, github, stripe or slack.

algorithm.description: Hash function (default SHA-256). Webhook presets always use SHA-256.

expected.description: Optional signature to verify, in hex or Base64, with or without a sha256= / v0= / v1= prefix.

key_encoding.description: How the key is written (default utf8).

message.description: The message or raw request body to sign.

message_encoding.description: How the message is written (default utf8). Ignored for webhook presets.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp used by the stripe and slack presets.

name: hmac
title: HMAC signature
